name: invoice-taggify
description: Root entry point for DigitalOcean App Platform: builds server + client-v2 (Next app served by the Express server), runs the Express server (same setup as render.yaml).

scripts.build: cd server && npm install --include=dev && npx prisma migrate deploy && cd ../client-v2 && npm install --include=dev && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=/api npm run build
